# ⚠️ Risk Acceptance Record

## Risk
Describe the unresolved risk and affected component.

## Impact and likelihood
Explain realistic outcomes, affected users and uncertainty.

## Existing controls
List controls already implemented and verification evidence.

## Compensating controls
Describe temporary safeguards and monitoring.

## Acceptance authority
Name the role authorized to accept the risk and the approval date.

## Expiry and review
Set a review date and explicit conditions that revoke acceptance.

## Remediation
Owner, action, priority and target milestone.

Do not use this template to waive privacy, legal or safety obligations.
